title: Format an attrition table from a cohort flow object — as_attrition_table
text: "flextable" – uses flextable officer packages. Renders natively Word (.docx) via officer::read_docx(), PDF via flextable::save_as_image(), HTML. Best choice Word primary target. "gt" – uses gt package. Renders HTML (gt::gtsave(..., "table.html")), LaTeX (gt::as_latex()), Word (via gt::gtsave(..., "table.docx") requires webshot2 package). Best choice LaTeX HTML primary target. "huxtable" – uses huxtable package. Supports Word, LaTeX, HTML output.
